facts.c: The Labour Law covers every employment contract performed in Cambodia, whatever the nationality of employer and worker or where the contract was signed (Art. 1)
facts.q: regardless of where the contract was made and what the nationality and residences of the contracted parties are

facts.c: A 'worker' under the Labour Law is any person of any sex and nationality who has an employment contract for pay (Art. 3)
facts.q: "Workers", in the sense of this law, are every person of all sex and nationality, who has signed an employment contract

facts.c: A foreigner may work only if he entered legally, holds a valid passport and a valid residence permit, and is fit for the job with no contagious disease (Art. 261)
facts.q: These foreigners must have legally entered the Kingdom of Cambodia

facts.c: The employer must tell workers clearly the wage terms before they are assigned to a job and whenever they change (Art. 112)
facts.q: The employer must take measures to inform the workers in a precise and easily comprehensible fashion of: a) The terms regarding wage that apply to the workers before they are assigned to a job

facts.c: Workers have the right, without distinction and without prior authorisation, to form and join unions of their choice (Art. 266)
facts.q: Workers and employers have, without distinction whatsoever and prior authorization, the right to form professional organizations of their own choice

facts.c: Conciliation and arbitration under the Labour Law are free of charge (Art. 316)
facts.q: The procedure for conciliation and arbitration shall be carried out free of charge.
